actions: Run baseline comparison before any stronger claim.
Do not interpret current feature list as a validated feature set.
Reassess business usefulness after baseline before allowing reporting.
reasons: Missingness is zero and no hard leakage was detected.
Duplicate rows exist but are relatively limited in proportion and do not by themselves justify blocking baseline comparison.
The current candidate feature set is still a raw all-non-target set, so usefulness must be re-judged after baseline rather than assumed.
summary: Continue to baseline, but carry forward explicit concerns about duplicate handling, lack of formal feature selection, and the need to reassess usefulness after baseline.
